title: Your first program: a message when your infobase starts
goal: Enter a small handler in the correct module, update the infobase and observe native output.

prerequisites.text: Your own empty file infobase opens in Designer. Start from zero explains normal installation.

sections.title: Where we begin
paragraphs: You edit a message, press Ctrl+S, then see the old text when the application runs. That does not yet justify rewriting the program. Three actions connect source text to a new message: save the definition, apply it to the infobase, and launch the application. Follow three lines, then test your own two-step sequence.

sections.title: From definition to action
paragraphs: The infobase has so far done nothing visible at startup. Add one action: display “Моя учебная служба работает” (“My training service desk works”). A message is immediately visible and needs no unexplained catalogs, arrays or functions. It creates no customers or documents. We are checking the specific chain from entered source to execution.

Enter the code in the managed application module. Select the configuration root, open its context menu and choose that module. Command placement can vary by version; use the managed application module, not an arbitrary common module. The platform invokes its startup handler when the application begins.

sections.title: Make a prediction first
paragraphs: You changed a message in Designer and only pressed Ctrl+S. Nothing changed in the already open application window. What should you check?
Answer before opening the reasoning.

reveal.title: Compare your prediction with the reasoning
paragraphs: Saving source text does not create a startup event in a running application. The intended infobase needs the updated configuration and a new launch.

tables.caption: What changes at each step
rows: The application has not yet run the new body
The selected infobase receives the change
A new launch invokes the handler
Compare the actual message with the new source

sections.title: Change the condition
paragraphs: Change only the message text and repeat all three actions. The new text tests whether the intended version executes. If the old text appears, first verify the selected infobase, completed update, and closure of the previous client.

sections.title: Read the three lines
paragraphs: Процедура ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы() declares a startup-event handler. For now, know that the platform invokes it at application startup. Сообщить("Моя учебная служба работает"); displays the supplied text. Ordinary double quotes delimit the string and a semicolon ends the instruction. КонецПроцедуры closes the declaration.

The course explains the same Russian-spelling BSL source in English. Do not replace ordinary quotes with typographic ones. If the startup handler already exists, add the message inside it and preserve its other lines rather than declaring a duplicate handler.

sections.title: Three separate operations
paragraphs: Saving preserves configuration source. Updating the database configuration applies the definition used by the running application. Starting Enterprise mode invokes the handler. Ctrl+S alone therefore produces no new runtime message; starting without applying changes can execute an earlier version.

Use Ctrl+S, Configuration → Update database configuration (usually F7), then Debug → Start debugging (usually F5). Read proposed changes before accepting. A personal empty infobase gives no reason to accept deletion of someone else’s objects. Wait for startup and locate the application message area.

flow.caption: From source to a new message
alternative: F7 updates the database configuration; it is not the syntax-check command.
F5 starts debugging and invokes the startup handler.
Record the actual message separately from the prediction.

sections.title: Saving is not execution
paragraphs: Each operation has a separate result.

code.source: Change text to “Проверяю новую версию” → Ctrl+S → F7 → F5
code.output: The changed text appears after the new startup.

tables.caption: Step-by-step reasoning
rows: The new application has not started yet.

sections.title: A changed version and a negative control
paragraphs: After success change only the message text, save, update and launch again. A changed output links observation to the new source version. If the old text remains, check the intended infobase and completed update instead of rewriting unrelated modules. Keep the working version available for return.

In a separate copy, a missing closing quote should produce a syntax diagnostic. Restore it before execution. This negative control checks diagnostics and does not justify damaging the main training project. The result is an observation of your launch, not an automatic knowledge assessment.

sections.title: When the result differs
paragraphs: If the handler already exists, add instructions inside it instead of declaring a duplicate. Repair a missing quote before launching; absence of syntax diagnostics and observation of the message are separate checks.
I save and wait for a message. Saving invokes no event; update the infobase and start the application.
I see old text. Check the selected infobase, completed update and a new client launch.

sections.title: A new task for your own work
paragraphs: When your learning service starts, display two messages in this order: «Заявка принята», then «Передана мастеру». Keep exactly one ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы handler. After a successful launch, change only the second message to «Передана мастеру — проверка 2», save, update and relaunch. Record both actual sequences. The BSL identifiers and required message text remain in Russian.
In Practice keep your prediction and actual observations. Viewing the example or reference preserves your work; you record the results of execution in installed 1C yourself.

practice.title: The first native message
practice.task: When your learning service starts, display two messages in this order: «Заявка принята», then «Передана мастеру». Keep exactly one ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы handler. After a successful launch, change only the second message to «Передана мастеру — проверка 2», save, update and relaunch. Record both actual sequences. The BSL identifiers and required message text remain in Russian.
practice.environment: Your own infobase in the official training edition; no Studio, archives or JSON required.
practice.externalRoute: Designer → managed application module → Enterprise mode

steps.title: Open the correct module
steps.action: Select the configuration root. Right-click → Открыть модуль приложения (Open application module, as observed in 8.3.27.2214; another version may explicitly say managed application module). Preserve any existing text separately.
steps.why: The handler must reside where the platform invokes it.
steps.expected: The intended module text window is open.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not enter it in a query window or arbitrary module; check the window name.
steps.before: Designer is open only for your training infobase. Preserve any existing code before editing.

steps.title: Enter the minimal source
steps.action: Keep one ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы handler. Add two Сообщить instructions for the required messages in order.
steps.expected: One handler, two instructions with ordinary quotes.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not replace unknown existing source; use your own empty copy instead.
steps.before: The intended module text window is open.

steps.title: Save and apply
steps.action: Press Ctrl+S, then Update database configuration (F7). Wait for successful completion and correct any syntax diagnostic first.
steps.why: The application uses the database configuration, not just open source text.
steps.troubleshooting: Check quotes and semicolons at the indicated line; a rejected attempt is not execution.
steps.before: One new message with ordinary quotes is in the handler.

steps.title: Start the application
steps.action: Launch your infobase after the completed update. Find Заявка принята followed by Передана мастеру in the message area. Record the actual sequence.
steps.troubleshooting: For old output close your client, verify the infobase and repeat updating. For no message check the module.

steps.title: Test a changed version
steps.where: The same module; then Enterprise mode
steps.action: Close your client. Change only the second message to Передана мастеру — проверка 2, repeat Ctrl+S → F7 → F5 and record both messages.
steps.why: Link a source change to observable output.
steps.troubleshooting: Nexus does not automatically inspect the external window; record your own observation.
steps.before: The application displays the intended text.
